name: @gingaf/node
description: Node.js middleware and static asset distribution package for GingaF Flutter Web

scripts.copy:assets: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const src='../ginga/build/web'; const dest='./assets'; if (fs.existsSync(dest)) fs.rmSync(dest, { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.mkdirSync(dest, { recursive: true }); fs.cpSync(src, dest, { recursive: true });"
scripts.build: npm run flutter:build && npm run copy:assets && tsc
